# walkingboxes

> Premium German-manufactured customizable food trailers and mobile kitchens for sustainable street food businesses.

walkingboxes is a Berlin-based company specializing in high-quality, sustainable food trailers with modular configurations (S, M, L models) and flexible financing options. The site serves entrepreneurs and food truck operators with product customization tools, industry insights, and comprehensive support resources.

## Key Topics

- Food Trailer Customization
- Mobile Kitchen
- Made in Germany
- Sustainability
- Street Food Business
- Food Truck Financing
- Shipping Container Design
- Stainless Steel Equipment
- Technical Specifications
- Food Trailer Configuration
- Mobile Gastronomy
- German Manufacturing
- Franchise Models
- Startup Funding

## Product & Configuration

- [Looking for a food truck? Buy a walkingboxes food trailer!](https://www.walkingboxes.de): Main walkingboxes site for purchasing sustainable, German-made food trailers
- [Konfiguriere Deinen Foodtrailer](https://www.walkingboxes.de/konfiguriere-deinen-foodtrailer): Interactive food trailer configurator for customizing models S, M, L with pricing
- [Verfügbare Foodtrailer](https://www.walkingboxes.de/verfuegbare-foodtrailer): Available food trailer inventory with specifications and premium kitchen equipment
- [FOODTRUCK Pop-Up Box](https://www.walkingboxes.de/pop-up-box): Pop-Up Box product line featuring specialized setups for pizza, burgers, and döner
- [Power of 15 LED String Light with Magnetic Mounting](https://www.walkingboxes.de/produkt/power-of-15-lichterkette-mit-magnet-x-befestigung): LED string light accessory with magnetic mounting for food trailer decoration

## Financing & Purchasing

- [Flexible Finanzierungsmodelle für deinen Foodtrailer](https://www.walkingboxes.de/finanzierung-leasing): Financing and leasing options for purchasing walkingboxes food trailers
- [Fördermittel für die Gastronomie](https://www.walkingboxes.de/foerdermittel-fuer-die-gastronomie-eine-finanzielle-stuetze-fuer-leidenschaftliche-neugruender): Guide to German funding programs (KfW, COSME) for gastro startup financing

## Manufacturing & Company

- [Wie unsere Foodtrailer entstehen](https://www.walkingboxes.de/ueber-uns/wie-unsere-foodtrailer-entstehen): Berlin-based manufacturing process and customization approach for food trailers
- [Buche jetzt deinen virtuellen Rundgang](https://www.walkingboxes.de/buche-jetzt-deinen-virtuellen-rundgang-durch-unseren-foodtrailer): Virtual tour booking for food trailer consultation and equipment planning

## Resources & Education

- [Foodtruck Blog](https://www.walkingboxes.de/ueber-uns/foodtruck-blog): Blog covering food truck trends, startup advice, franchising, and revenue analysis
- [Food Trucks 2025: Chancen und Trends](https://www.walkingboxes.de/food-trucks-2025-chancen-und-trends-fuer-die-mobile-gastronomie): 2025 food truck trends covering sustainability, vegan options, and digital technology
- [Erfolgreicher Franchisegeber im Streetfood Business](https://www.walkingboxes.de/erfolgreicher-franchisegeber-im-streetfood-business-werden-ein-leitfaden-fuer-deinen-foodtruck-erfolg): Franchise guide for expanding food truck concepts and street food businesses

## Optional

- [Versand](https://www.walkingboxes.de/versand): Shipping policy for food trailers and accessories across Germany and Europe
